definitions: A type of luxury good for which the demand increases as the price increases, in apparent contradiction of the law of demand, because of its exclusive nature and appeal as a status symbol.
A good for which the quantity demanded rises as the price rises, over a certain price range.
examples: High-end designer handbags are often considered Veblen goods.
The market for luxury cars often behaves like a Veblen good market.
Some rare artworks function as Veblen goods.
